p.id AS posting_id, p.company, p.title, p.city, p.salary_note, p.source, p.archived, p.updated_at, p.active_version_id, p.application_id, v.version_number AS active_version_number, JSON_LENGTH(v.required_skills_json) AS requirement_count, a.company AS application_company, a.role AS application_role, a.stage AS application_stage, (SELECT MAX(m.created_at) FROM job_match_result m JOIN job_posting_version pv ON pv.id = m.job_posting_version_id WHERE pv.job_posting_id = p.id) AS last_matched_at, (SELECT m.confirmation_status FROM job_match_result m JOIN job_posting_version pv ON pv.id = m.job_posting_version_id WHERE pv.job_posting_id = p.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_match_confirmation_status
FROM job_posting p LEFT JOIN job_posting_version v ON v.id = p.active_version_id LEFT JOIN job_application a ON a.id = p.application_id
